'''Mok's Cheap Eats''' was a restaurant in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], catering to factory workers.

It was during a meeting there in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] that [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] agreed to work together to tear down the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] so that it could be [[Galactic Empire/Legends|rebuilt]], and Dooku informed Palpatine that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] might be the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]].
